### Setup

```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(rprojroot)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(ggforce)
  library(cowplot)
  library(Biobase)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
})

root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "human-neuronal-expression")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))
``` 

### Identify GO terms related to neuronal gene sets

```{r}
category_keywords <- c(
  "synaptic_vesicle",
  "neurotransmitter",
  "postsynaptic",
  "cell_adhesion",
  "neuromodulatory",
  "glutamatergic",
  "gabaergic",
  "cholinergic",
  "serotonergic",
  "purinergic",
  "adrenergic"
)
```

```{r}
# Clean GSVA table column name
gsva_result_file <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses/human-rna-expression/results/gobp-gsva-scores-with-target-genes.tsv")
gsva_df <- read_tsv(gsva_result_file)

neuronal_go_terms <- gsva_df %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(tolower(Pathway),
               paste(category_keywords, collapse = "|"))
  )

# Save output
write_tsv(
  neuronal_go_terms,
  file.path(results_dir, "neuronal_gobp_terms_from_gsva.tsv")
)

message("Total neuronal-related GO BP pathways identified: ",
        nrow(neuronal_go_terms))
```

### Perform correlation analysis

```{r}
mirna_tpm_file <- file.path(
  root_dir,
  "analyses",
  "immune-deconvolution",
  "results",
  "mirna-tpm.rds"
)

de_mirna_file <- file.path(
  root_dir,
  "analyses",
  "human-mirna-expression",
  "results",
  "DIPG or DMG_sig_DE_miRNA_list.csv"
)

histology_file <- file.path(
  root_dir,
  "analyses",
  "histology-preprocessing",
  "results",
  "histologies.tsv"
)
```

```{r}
hist <- read_tsv(histology_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

dmg_mirna_ids <- hist %>% 
  dplyr::filter(experimental_strategy == "miRNA-Seq",
                sample_type == "Tumor",
                histology == "DIPG or DMG",
                !external_sample_id %in% c("1-1855-CC1", 
                                           "4-1958-CC1")) %>%
  arrange(external_sample_id) %>%
  pull(external_sample_id)

dmg_rna_ids <- hist %>% 
  dplyr::filter(experimental_strategy == "RNA-Seq",
                sample_type == "Tumor",
                histology == "DIPG or DMG") %>%
  arrange(external_sample_id) %>%
  pull(Bioassay_ID)

de_mirna <- read_csv(de_mirna_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
de_mirna_ids <- unique(de_mirna$miRNA)
```

```{r}
mirna_tpm <- readRDS(mirna_tpm_file) %>%
  dplyr::filter(rownames(.) %in% de_mirna_ids) %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(dmg_mirna_ids))
mirna_tpm <- log2(as.matrix(mirna_tpm) + 1)

gsva_score <- neuronal_go_terms %>%
  column_to_rownames("Pathway")

gsva_mat <- gsva_score %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c(dmg_rna_ids))) %>%
  as.matrix()
```

```{r}
# Spearman correlation
rho_mat <- cor(t(mirna_tpm), t(gsva_mat), method = "spearman")
rho_mat_filtered <- rho_mat[rowSums(is.na(rho_mat)) != ncol(rho_mat), ]

# p-values (approx)
n <- ncol(mirna_tpm)
t_val <- rho_mat_filtered * sqrt((n-2)/(1 - rho_mat_filtered^2))
pval_mat <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_val), df = n-2)

# Long format with BH adjustment per miRNA
corr_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(rho_mat_filtered)) %>%
  rename(miRNA = Var1, Pathway = Var2, rho = Freq) %>%
  mutate(pval = as.vector(pval_mat)) %>%
  group_by(miRNA) %>%
  mutate(padj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(miRNA, desc(abs(rho)))

# Save the table
write_tsv(corr_df, file.path(results_dir, "mirna_neuronal_gobp_spearman.tsv"))

corr_df_sig_01 <- corr_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.1)

write_tsv(corr_df_sig_01, file.path(results_dir, "mirna_neuronal_gobp_spearman_FDR01.tsv"))
```
